skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply theoretical and practical knowledge in land management to analyze and evaluate real-world issues.
Analyze and solve problems related to land management.
Identify and evaluate land policies to address specific management issues.
Conduct independent research and present findings effectively.
Effectively communicate research findings and ideas in both written and oral formats.
Collaborate with peers and instructors in group settings.
Identify and propose solutions to land management issues.
Manage and complete individual and group projects within deadlines.
Understand and apply relevant laws and regulations related to land management.
Observe and analyze real-world land management scenarios.
